# Test fixtures

Shared, **synthetic** sample data. Never commit real customer data: names, e-mails and phone
numbers in these files are invented (`example.com`, `+39 000 000000x`).

`.gitattributes` marks `tests/fixtures/**` as `-text`: bytes are stored exactly as written, so the
UTF-8 BOM and Windows-1252 files keep their encoding on every platform.

## `bookings/` (Gate 2)

| File | Purpose |
| ---- | ------- |
| `en_comma.csv` | English headers, comma, ISO dates |
| `it_semicolon.csv` | Italian headers, semicolon, day-first dates, decimal comma and thousands dot |
| `utf8_bom.csv` | the English file with a UTF-8 BOM |
| `cp1252.csv` | Italian file in Windows-1252 with accented text |
| `pii_unmapped_columns.csv` | guest name / e-mail / phone / notes columns that must never be persisted |
| `unknown_status.csv` | a status value that is not recognised (row must be reported, not defaulted) |
| `ambiguous_dates.csv` | day/month-first dates that need a configured format |
| `duplicate_source_id.csv` | the same source record id twice in one file |
| `invalid_row.csv` | a row with a negative amount, zero rooms and check-out before check-in |
| `changed_schema.csv` | a mapped column (`Check-in`) renamed |
| `masseria_ninfa_bookings_v1.csv` | **golden mini import**: 16 bookings of a fictional agriturismo (direct, Booking.com-like labels, Expedia, Airbnb, an agency, a tour operator; confirmed, cancelled, no-show; lead times from days to months; commissions, room types, a booking made right after the spring clock change) |
| `masseria_ninfa_bookings_v1.expected.json` | its canonical result, computed **independently of the application code** with the standard library only (`csv`, `zoneinfo`, `decimal`); rows MN-0001, MN-0009 (booked at 03:30 on the spring clock-change day: the skipped hour is deliberately not used, a naive local time in it is rejected) and MN-0016 were also checked by hand |

XLSX files are generated by the tests (`tests/booking_support.py`) instead of being committed as
binaries. The golden result is only source file → canonical bookings: no metric or decision is
derived from it.
